pairs.why: Both hats are almost the same, but B's felt is slightly smoother and more evenly lit, closer to the clean toy finish of the real cards than A's more textured, darker-vignetted felt.
B has a slightly cleaner, smoother surface and brighter light, matching the real cards; A's felt grain reads a bit more photographic.
B is a little smoother and softer in finish, while A shows more fuzzy felt texture, which the lessons count against.
A's crown and brim have heavier felt grain and harder shading; B is smoother and brighter, closer to the real cards' clean render.
Both show the same felt-textured fedora at about the same smoothness and light, with no clear difference in finish or construction.
B's surface is slightly cleaner and less grainy than A's, closer to the smooth but not glassy finish of the real cards.
B's crown looks slightly fuzzier and puffier, while A is a touch cleaner, though the difference is minimal.
A has a wider, flatter brim and more visible felt grain; B is more compact and smoothly rendered, closer to the chunky, clean real objects.
